crossRefs.note: It was so, when the days of their feasting had run their course, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early…
crossRefs.keyword: the thing, etc. Heb. I feared a fear and it came upon me.that which

crossRefs.note: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing.
crossRefs.keyword: the thing, etc. Heb. I feared a fear and it came upon me.that which

translations.web: For the thing which I fear comes on me, That which I am afraid of comes to me.
translations.bsb: For the thing I feared has overtaken me, and what I dreaded has befallen me.
translations.kjv: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come
translations.asv: For the thing which I fear cometh upon me, And that which I am afraid of cometh unto me.
